articles.name: Articles (Technical Architecture Comparison)
articles.goal: Understand trade-offs between monolithic and microservices architectures

pages.title: Monolith First by Martin Fowler
pages.description: Why starting with a monolith is almost always the right choice
pages.importantText:
Title: Monolith First
Author: Martin Fowler
Date: 2015
Main Thesis: Don't start with microservices even if you are certain your application will be big enough. Start with a monolith, keep it modular, and split once boundaries are clear.
Trade-offs Discussed: Operational complexity, deployment speed, debugging ease.
Performance Benchmarks: NOT PROVIDED

pages.title: Pattern: Monolithic Architecture by Chris Richardson
pages.description: An architectural pattern that structures an application as a single deployable unit
pages.importantText:
Title: Pattern: Monolithic Architecture
Author: Chris Richardson
Date: 2021
Main Thesis: Monolithic architectures simplify development and end-to-end testing early on, but maintenance and deployment friction grows exponentially as team size expands.
Trade-offs Discussed: Team autonomy, technology lock-in, scaling bottlenecks.
Performance Benchmarks: NOT PROVIDED
